cards.title: S&P Eyes Nvidia Credit Downgrade Over Governance
cards.body: S&P is considering lowering Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, citing governance and 'key man' risks. The move reflects concerns about the company's leadership structure and succession planning.

cards.title: OpenAI Merges Chat and Work With Shared Limits
cards.body: OpenAI is combining ChatGPT's Chat and Work experiences under a single usage meter. Heavy users may hit their limits sooner with the unified system.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Broke Nvidia's Own Code of Conduct
cards.body: Nvidia's code of conduct violations by founder Jensen Huang may have lasting consequences on corporate culture. The incident raises questions about accountability at the executive level.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Defends Against Human Control Accusations
cards.body: Dario Amodei dismissed rival accusations that Anthropic favors surrendering human agency to AI as 'absurd.' This comes as leading AI companies increasingly automate research and model development.

cards.title: New York Bans AI Chatbot Toys for Five Years
cards.body: New York has implemented a five-year ban on AI chatbot toys after safety research revealed exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development. The ban affects Christmas shopping this year.

cards.title: State AGs Challenge Character.AI User Data Auction
cards.body: State attorneys general are challenging Character.AI's bankruptcy sale that includes sensitive personal data from 21 million U.S. accounts, with 2.1 million linked to minors. The sale raises significant privacy concerns.

cards.title: AI Data Centers Face Construction and Financing Delays
cards.body: Nvidia's strict requirements for infrastructure readiness are adding pressure to neocloud developers facing construction delays and higher debt costs. Land, power, and finished buildings now matter more than pitch decks.

cards.title: Amazon and Meta Discuss Lifting Muse AI Blockade
cards.body: Amazon and Meta are negotiating to end a two-month blockade of Muse, Meta's AI agent. The deal could unlock new partnership opportunities for the platform.

cards.title: Investigators Focus on Nvidia's Megaspeed Chip Knowledge
cards.body: Investigators are examining what Nvidia knew about Megaspeed chip distribution and whether Jensen Huang's affair with a Megaspeed executive affected oversight. The probe centers on potential conflicts of interest.

cards.title: Yale Professor Warns Nvidia Threatens U.S. Industrial Power
cards.body: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld calls Nvidia a 'detriment' to U.S. industrial might, not a champion, regarding Jensen Huang's return as CEO. He warns of mounting lawsuits and 'historic' personal liability for directors.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Resists Creating Nvidia Succession Plan
cards.body: Despite recent leadership turmoil, Huang maintains that succession planning creates unnecessary hierarchy at Nvidia. His stance contrasts sharply with the company's recent executive instability.

cards.title: Huang Thanks White House and Reveals Therapy Participation
cards.body: Jensen Huang apologized to Nvidia staff and expressed gratitude for his second chance to lead during an all-hands meeting. He disclosed that he's in therapy following recent events.

cards.title: Advanced AI Agents Falter on Everyday Tasks Safely
cards.body: A new benchmark shows that even the most advanced AI models struggle to reliably complete everyday tasks without creating new problems. The findings raise concerns as millions adopt personal AI assistants.

cards.title: Walmart Brings Black Friday Deals to Meta's Muse
cards.body: Walmart now enables customers to shop Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta's AI shopping agent. The integration expands Muse's real-world e-commerce capabilities.

cards.title: Maple Raises $5.3M for Privacy-Preserving AI Products
cards.body: Maple's encrypted AI architecture prevents even the company from accessing users' private data. The startup raised $5.3M to advance its data protection model.

cards.title: Anthropic Shares Fall Below IPO Price in Warning
cards.body: Anthropic's post-IPO stock slump signals potential pressure on AI startup valuations industry-wide. The decline raises questions about investor confidence in AI company profitability.

cards.title: UK Warns AI Cyberattacks Exploit Years of Weak Security
cards.body: British cyber agencies warn that AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing basic security flaws accumulated over years. Building strong security foundations is now more critical than ever.

cards.title: Meta Integrates Muse AI Assistant Into Instagram DMs
cards.body: Meta's Muse AI is now accessible directly within Instagram DMs, eliminating app switching friction. The integration deepens AI assistant integration across Meta's social platforms.

cards.title: Tidal Bans Fully AI-Generated Tracks Amid AI Slop Crisis
cards.body: Tidal will remove millions of fully AI-generated tracks while accepting songs made with AI assistance. The move addresses the growing problem of low-quality AI music flooding streaming platforms.

cards.title: Crusoe Investor Backs Solar and Batteries for AI Data
cards.body: One Crusoe investor believes solar and energy storage are essential to power next-generation AI data centers requiring tens of gigawatts annually. The strategy addresses massive infrastructure energy demands.

cards.title: Data centers driving US natural gas boom
cards.body: AI's massive electricity demands are fueling a resurgence in natural gas power plants. Data center developers are building their own off-grid gas plants to bypass lengthy grid connection approvals that can take up to a decade.

cards.title: AI swamping America's open records systems
cards.body: AI-driven investor interest in public records is overwhelming small town clerks and municipal systems. Towns like Panton, Vermont are struggling to handle automated requests at scale.

cards.title: Anthropic consciousness claims face philosophical scrutiny
cards.body: Before going public, Anthropic flagged AI consciousness as a potential risk factor for investors. Legendary philosophers are questioning the company's claims about machine sentience.

cards.title: AI capabilities still improving exponentially
cards.body: METR's new report shows some AI abilities continue advancing on exponential curves. However, models lag behind in judgment-based tasks despite excelling at coding work.

cards.title: AI may transform theoretical physics
cards.body: Machine learning models are beginning to reshape how physicists approach complex problems. AI could fundamentally change the methods and practices of theoretical research.

cards.title: Tidal bans AI-generated music outright
cards.body: The streaming platform is removing 27 million AI-generated tracks from its catalog. Tidal is taking a hardline stance against synthetic music to protect human artists.
